name: Amazon

eyebrow.en: Amazon.com, Inc. · Common stock · Seattle, Washington
eyebrow.zh: 亚马逊 · 普通股 · 华盛顿州西雅图

title.en: AWS is back, and so is the capex.
title.zh: AWS 回来了，资本开支也来了。

lede.en: Amazon grew revenue 20% to $200.6B last quarter and AWS accelerated to 37%, its fastest in 18 quarters. Profit got a $53B paper gain from its Anthropic stake. Cash capex of about $220B this year has turned trailing free cash flow negative.
lede.zh: 亚马逊上季营收增 20% 至 2006 亿美元，AWS 增速加快至 37%，为 18 个季度以来最快。利润因 Anthropic 持股获得 530 亿美元账面收益。今年约 2200 亿美元的现金资本开支使近12月自由现金流转负。

s.zh: GAAP 历史，含约 530 亿 Anthropic 收益

sub_price.en: Daily closes with the 50-day average. The stock ranged from about $196 to $287 over the past year and jumped about 15% after Q2 results.
sub_price.zh: 每日收盘价与50日均线。过去一年股价在约 $196 至 $287 间，第二季财报后上涨约 15%。

sub_rev.en: Revenue in US$ millions, with gross margin on the right axis. Q2 2026 GAAP EPS of $5.75 includes a $53.4B pre-tax gain on Anthropic. Q4 is the holiday peak. The last bar is guidance at the midpoint.
sub_rev.zh: 营收单位为百万美元，右轴为毛利率。2026 年第二季 GAAP 每股 $5.75 含 534 亿美元 Anthropic 税前收益。第四季为假日旺季。最后一根柱为指引中值。

p.en: AWS grew 37% with a 39% operating margin and about $496B of contracted backlog. Jassy says capacity, not demand, is the limit into 2027.
p.zh: AWS 增长 37%，营业利润率 39%，已签约储备约 4960 亿美元。贾西称至 2027 年限制因素是产能而非需求。

p.en: The Trainium business runs above $25B a year, anchored by Anthropic's 10-year, up-to-$100B commitment.
p.zh: Trainium 业务年化逾 250 亿美元，以 Anthropic 十年、最多 1000 亿美元的承诺为支撑。

h.zh: 资本开支与自由现金流

p.en: Trailing 12-month free cash flow was −$7.6B, versus +$18.2B a year earlier. Long-term debt roughly doubled in 2026 to fund the build-out.
p.zh: 近12月自由现金流 −76 亿美元（一年前 +182 亿）。为支持扩建，2026 年长期债务约翻倍。

p.en: The Anthropic markup inflates GAAP EPS; it is not cash and can reverse.
p.zh: Anthropic 估值上调推高 GAAP 每股收益；这不是现金，且可能反转。

p.en: Q4 is Amazon's biggest quarter for sales and operating cash flow.
p.zh: 第四季是亚马逊营收与经营现金流最高的季度。

h.zh: 第四季业绩与 2027 资本开支

p.en: Expected to include the 2027 capex outlook.
p.zh: 预计给出 2027 年资本开支展望。

sources: Price, market cap, beta and earnings date: Financial Modeling Prep, as of Oct 9, 2026

foot.en: Fundamentals as of Oct 9, 2026. For information only, not investment advice. Not affiliated with Amazon.com, Inc..
foot.zh: 基本面数据截至 2026年10月9日。仅供参考，不构成投资建议。与 Amazon.com, Inc. 无关联。

sub.en: Free cash flow is operating cash flow minus capital spending, in US$ millions, for the 20 quarters from Q3 2021 to Q2 2026. Shaded bars and italic rows are estimates.
sub.zh: 自由现金流 = 经营现金流 − 资本开支，单位百万美元，涵盖 2021 年第三季至 2026 年第二季共 20 个季度。浅色柱与斜体行为估算。

read.en: Amazon's free cash flow is seasonal: weak or negative in the first half, strong in the holiday quarter. Over five years it swung between about −$18B and +$28B a quarter. In 2026 capex jumped to $44–54B a quarter, so even the strong quarters barely break even and the first half was −$27B.
read.zh: 亚马逊自由现金流有季节性：上半年弱或为负，假日季强。五年间每季在约 −180 亿至 +280 亿美元之间波动。2026 年资本开支跃升至每季 440–540 亿，即使旺季也仅勉强持平，上半年为 −270 亿。

read.en: With about $220B of cash capex guided for 2026 and $98B spent in the first half, the second half needs about $122B. I expect about −$18B in Q3, roughly breakeven in the holiday quarter, and a deeper hole in early 2027 if capex keeps rising: about −$69B over four quarters, funded by its cash and new bonds.
read.zh: 2026 年现金资本开支指引约 2200 亿美元，上半年已花 980 亿，下半年需约 1220 亿。我预计第三季约 −180 亿、假日季约持平；若资本开支继续上升，2027 年初缺口加深：四季合计约 −690 亿，以现金和新发债券弥补。

p.en: Cash capex of $53.1B in Q2, mostly AWS and generative AI, with ~$220B planned for 2026.
p.zh: 第二季现金资本开支 531 亿美元，主要用于 AWS 与生成式 AI，2026 年计划约 2200 亿。

p.en: The capex guide rose partly because memory got more expensive.
p.zh: 资本开支指引上调部分因内存涨价。

p.en: $59.5B of debt issued in Q1 2026 and $22.9B in Q2.
p.zh: 2026 年第一季举债 595 亿美元，第二季 229 亿。

bridgeNote.en: Before any new bonds; Amazon has been issuing debt regularly in 2026.
bridgeNote.zh: 未计入新发债券；亚马逊 2026 年持续发债。

extraNote.en: The Anthropic gain is a non-cash markup and does not affect cash flow.
extraNote.zh: Anthropic 收益为非现金估值上调，不影响现金流。
